markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?

eventMetadata.context_description: The crowded 2028 Democratic field remains wide open more than two years before primaries, with no candidate securing broad commitments or dominant polling leads. Trader consensus positions Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez narrowly ahead due to her high name recognition, large social media following, and appeal among progressive voters, while Jon Ossoff and Gavin Newsom trail closely amid buzz around their Senate and gubernatorial records. Recent DNC approval of a revised primary calendar—starting with South Carolina in January 2028—could shift early dynamics toward candidates strong with Black, Latino, and union voters. Most potential contenders have avoided formal declarations, leaving room for shifts from midterm results, policy debates, or emerging endorsements before the race consolidates.
